terms.definition: The fraction of substituted, deleted, and inserted words relative to a reference transcript; lower is better.
A standard machine-translation metric scoring n-gram overlap between generated and reference translations; higher is better.
Evaluating a model on a dataset without using any of that dataset's training data or fine-tuning on it.
The gap between a model's expected performance on out-of-distribution data and what its in-distribution performance would predict; a way to isolate generalization from raw accuracy.
Training pairs (audio and transcript) collected without curated, hand-verified labeling, so individual labels may be noisy.
Transcribing audio longer than the model's 30-second input window by sliding/buffering the model over the recording and stitching outputs.
